Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of what we discussed and the proposed next steps so we have a mutual action plan: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference runtime for low-latency clinical summarization (500 token docs) and embedding similarity for triage routing.
- Success criteria: median token latency < 120ms under 10rps and embedding recall > 0.92 on your test set.
- What we’ll deliver: a 2-week POC environment (dedicated pool) with a preloaded test dataset, sample prompts, and an initial cost/latency dashboard.
- Next steps (owner / ETA):
  1) Redwood to provision trial workspace and baseline config (Marcus) — target: Nov 4
  2) Greenleaf to share a sanitized sample of 200 test documents and the evaluation script (Priya / ops) — target: Nov 5
  3) Joint validation session (30m) to run first pass and validate instrumentation — target: week of Nov 8

I’ve attached a one-page trial plan and an onboarding checklist for your infra team. If anything above looks off, flag it and I’ll update.

If your priority has shifted, please say so — we can adjust timeline or scope (shorter smoke test, private deployment later).

Thanks,
Hannah
